prompt: With picker_h, take the fullest bin at bin_row to dock_b. Bins are swapped in and out all shift, so go by what is on the row when you start.

expect_2_3.because: 0045 C9 (choosing by a reading of each candidate)

why: Choosing by a reading of each candidate (0045 C3, C9): `where` and `nearest to` use world facts, never a reading, because a reading is a sequence of robot actions, not a choice. G-EACH. With two or three named bins it is a 2.2 program (compare the names in an `if`, `c02`); here the set is whatever is on the row when the job starts.
